scope: Local tracked modifications and nonignored untracked files before this planning pass
git_hash_contract: Git blob object IDs after git hash-object clean filters; not raw file SHA-256 or backups
exclusions: Files created by this planning pass
limits: Equality applies to individual file content, not semantic equivalence of all hunks
Different content may be older than published branches; do not treat every difference as a new feature
Local refs used without a new fetch; no remote run status inferred
Hashes do not preserve uncommitted file contents; actual files remain in the original worktree
